# synology_time (Resource)

DSM NTP and time-zone configuration. This resource never sets the wall clock directly. Synchronization success depends on the NAS network policy.

## Adopt existing settings

1. Add the import block below with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.
2. Set your arguments to the values DSM currently reports. The sample configuration shows the shape and uses example values.
3. Run `terraform plan`. For one import, apply only when it reports `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_time.main
  id = "time"
}
```

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_time" "main" {
  synchronization = "ntp"
  ntp_server      = "time.example.org"
  timezone        = "Seoul"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `date_format` (String) DSM date display format.
- `ntp_server` (String) NTP server name.
- `synchronization` (String) DSM synchronization mode; ntp enables NTP.
- `time_format` (String) DSM time display format.
- `timezone` (String) DSM time-zone identifier, such as Seoul.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: time. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
